Level 6 is where it separates: Spiraling Despair throws 1300 against Karma's 950 Q, so he answers her commits from outside her range entirely.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's headline defect: the page named none of Hwei's real abilities. It instead used 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' in eleven fields, 'Painted Fear (R)' in four, and 'Severance (E)' in two. breakdown.cooldowns also held no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: His E palette is Subject: Torment (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s), which contains Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw — that is where all his crowd control lives. His R is Spiraling Despair. Subject: Disaster is 10/9/8/7/6s and costs 80 mana at rank 1; Subject: Serenity is 18s. His passive matters too and was never mentioned: the first damaging spell primes the target and the SECOND completes the signature, which is precisely why dodging the Torment root stops the chain rather than merely reducing it.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced with the real one, and breakdown.cooldowns, tradeGood, tradeBad and the dos/donts now carry the 12s Torment, the 10s/80-mana Disaster, the 18s Serenity and the 120s/1300 Spiraling Despair, plus the two-spell signature condition.

CHART: full layer said 'Skill' on rows 0-5; content and the packet levelChart both read Skill x4 then Hwei x3. Moved phases[4].side and phases[5].side to Hwei and rewrote all seven whys. No paired win[N] edits — win[0..6] already hold the target values on disk.
